column1: # Oman, the Ministry of Awqaf and Religious Affairs (authorities-arab-world-turkiye.md): 18°/18°,
# Dhuhr, Asr and Maghrib + 5, rounded up at Muscat, the sun taken once a day at about 0h UT, 86 localities at
# their own coordinates. Only Muscat's table is held: checked at the Muscat unit's point. The fast
# begins at the printed Fajr (F+E). Standard Asr.
# Split, forward and back in time: fit on Muscat's 2026 year; held out, its January and July 2021
# and March and September 2031 (the 2021–2031 file holds those four months only).
# The ministry's all-localities day page (calendar_page4.asp, one plain GET a day), read for every day from
# 1 November 2026 to 31 December 2027 and for the 1st and 15th of each month of 2029 on 12 Nov 2026
# (archive/code/manual/om-mara/mara_days.py): all 86 localities, Ramadan 1448 among it. Muscat is checked at the
# app's point, the 85 others at the ministry's own points, fitted from their 2026–2027 days
# (archive/code/manual/om-mara/fit_points.py) with every time but Muscat's rounded to the nearest minute (rulings
# R166, R169): those rows are `fit` (the points were fitted on them; the margins are Muscat's, fitted with
# -Pfit=om.mara/muscat), and the 2029 days, which no point was fitted on, are held out. Al Hamra is checked at the
# town, its table's own point riding beside (R170). Muscat's November and December 2026 print the same minutes as
# its 2026 row above, so only its 2027 and 2029 are rows.
